messages:
maya: opened a docs PR to update Zenith7B model card — clarifying supported variants, max seq per variant, embedding-shard behavior, and splitting bench rows by variant+quant. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5142 :sparkles:

derek: thanks. can you call out which variants are safe for embedding sharding? last customer hit alignment drift when merging shards for the compact-int8 build. :thinking:

maya: yep. draft now lists: zenith7b-fp16 (shardable), zenith7b-int8-shardable (shardable), zenith7b-int8-compact (non-shardable, see rationale). added a short Troubleshooting note with the exact merge command and a link to embeddings troubleshooting.

sophia: bench question  public catalog showed higher tokens/sec for the fp16 variant. are we mixing GPUs or batch sizes? customers expect GPU column in the bench table.

maya: fixed the table: columns now variant | GPU | batch_size | seq_len | tokens/s. split rows for pinned-seqlen vs variable runs and included the raw perf command used. GPUs: A100-80GB for pinned 64k experiments, A100-40GB for 32k.

derek: SDK snippet request: please add a TypeScript example showing streaming generation on the 64k variant with graceful CPU fallback and an embeddings example with shard_hint taxonomy. keep them tiny.

maya: adding two TS snippets. generation snippet:

```ts
import Redwood from '@redwoodai/sdk'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY })
const stream = client.generate.stream({
  model: 'zenith7b-pro-64k',
  input: 'Analyze error logs and summarize root causes',
  fallback: { mode: 'cpu' }
})
for await (const chunk of stream) console.log(chunk.text)
```

embeddings snippet:

```ts
import Redwood from '@redwoodai/sdk'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY })
const emb = await client.embeddings.create({
  model: 'zenith7b-fp16',
  input: 'User support ticket...',
  shard_hint: 'support:long'
})
console.log(emb.data[0].embedding.length)
```

sophia: nit  use shard_hint taxonomy "support:long" as you did and link to https://docs.redwood.ai/embeddings/sharding. also call out that the compact-int8 variant should be documented as non-shardable in the top summary so sales/support don't miss it.

qa-raj: please add the eval checklist before we merge: reproduce pinned 64k on A100-80GB, reproduce 32k on A100-40GB, run tokenization diff on 100 mixed prompts (lang+code), and run embedding-shard idempotency for shardable variants. I'll queue tests once draft is ready (ETA ~5h). If idempotency fails we'll block the merge.

doc-lint-bot: lint: models/zenith7b.md  headings OK; found two markdown-link warnings (lines 84, 139) and one long line (line 107).

maya: fixing links and line wrap. added migration advice for customers moving from runtime v2.x to v3.x (tokenization caveat + recommended runtime flags for long windows). assigned reviewers @derek @sophia @qa-raj. target merge before next catalog cut. :calendar:
